name: model behaviour
description: The model produced wrong, fabricated, unsafe or off-policy output with correct inputs
example: Assistant invents a refund policy clause

name: prompt/guardrail gap
description: A system prompt, instruction or guardrail allowed or caused the failure, including prompt injection
example: New instruction overrides the fee policy; injected text obeyed

name: retrieval/data
description: Retrieved context or source data was missing, stale, wrong or over-permissive

name: evaluation gap
description: No eval case, threshold or red-team test covered the failure before release
example: Golden set had no fee-waiver cases

name: monitoring gap
description: No alert, SLO or dashboard detected the failure in time
example: Detected from support tickets, not telemetry

name: change management
description: A change reached users without review, staging, canary or rollback readiness
example: Prompt shipped to 100% traffic at once

name: capacity/cost
description: Token, rate-limit, quota, GPU or budget limits caused or worsened the incident

name: third-party/model provider
description: A model provider, API or vendor change or outage contributed
example: Provider model version changed without notice

name: human process
description: A runbook, handoff, training, staffing or decision process gap (a process, never a person)
example: No on-call owner for the AI feature on weekends
